item.title: Virginia Beach sees significant crime reduction as police chief reports safest conditions in 5 years
item.description: Virginia Beach police report significant crime reductions across all major categories, with violent crime down 30% since 2023 and juvenile shootings cut in half.

item.title: Franklin City police looking for missing 16-year-old boy
item.description: 16-year-old Zachary Corsiglia is missing from the city of Franklin. He left his home on Hunterdale Road in Franklin on Feb. 3 and has not been seen since. He is autistic and receives medication.

item.title: Ball in the family: King's Fork's Hite leads Bulldog boys while cheering on daughter Rylie
item.description: While Rick has been the head coach of the King's Fork boys team for the last nine seasons, Rylie has grown into a star guard for the Bulldog girls.
